research_gaps: The added cardio-protective role of ACE inhibitors/ARBs in post-ACS patients without reduced LVEF on otherwise optimal medical therapy needs to be clarified.

The future role of new treatment options using mRNA- and siRNA-based therapies targeting lipid metabolism and inflammation needs exploration; randomized data are needed to evaluate these therapies in the current context of lipid management and lipid targets.
It must be determined whether SGLT2 inhibitors in the specific group of patients with ACS without heart failure or diabetes improve clinical outcomes regardless of diabetes status.
ACS patients without HF or diabetes should be randomized to SGLT2 inhibitors vs. standard of care.
patient_perspectives: Assess feasibility of performing short witnessed verbal consent followed by written consent after the acute phase.
Need to evaluate contribution of social determinants of health on ACS incidence and prognosis and study interventions to reduce social inequalities.
Increase use of validated patient-reported outcome and experience measures (PROMs/PREMs) in evidence-based medicine and RCTs evaluating ACS patients.
Quality of life should be included as a prominent outcome in clinical trials.
Test and use validated decision aids and audio-visual tools to help patients make informed choices.

Associated Conditions: cardio-protection in patients with preserved LVEF
